item.title: UN reaches climate accord
item.description: Delegates agreed to a binding framework after two weeks of talks.
item.content:encoded:
Delegates from 194 countries agreed on Friday to a binding framework that commits signatories to steeper emissions cuts through the end of the decade.

The final text was adopted by consensus shortly after midnight.
